canon_basis: Seven men discard dates, load the eleven loads of birthday treasure into seven Jiangzhou carts, cover the goods and push the carts down Huangnigang. Liu Tang has the existing chapter14/16 identity and shirtless merchant appearance.
art_interpretations: Single central wooden wheel and two balanced cargo beds; original does not specify wheel count
Grey-brown cloth, hemp rope placement, black headcloth and grey trousers follow game art design
No weapon in hands while pushing; exact weapon stowage is not described
Five authored single-pose four-view atlases are candidates, not accepted motion
